title: Yamaha DX7 - the 32 classic factory patches
summary: A run through the 32 factory presets of the Yamaha DX7 FM synthesizer, with timestamps for each patch such as brass, strings, pianos, bass and tubular bells. It is a straight audio demo of the sounds.
why: HN uses it as a reference for how DX7 patches and FM synthesis actually sound.

quote.text: This demonstrates the factory patches; the train patch (#31) seems to have several different distinct timbres
